findings.title: Offline verification accepts internally invalid qualification certificates
findings.observation: Two certificates with a failed observation, top-level pass and stale self-digest are accepted after outer hashes are refreshed. Trusted verifier reports pass for all 28 checks.
findings.required_remediation: Validate closed certificate shape, self-digest, required observation membership and aggregate result, and plan/profile/run-receipt/evidence links in builder and standalone verifier. Add internally inconsistent evidence regressions with refreshed outer hashes. Produce a successor candidate and rerun affected verification and independent review.
findings.claim_limit: Does not establish invalidity of original qualification runs. Immutable original manifest binding rejects changed bundle; source-commit-only verifier still must reject inconsistent internal claims.
